title: VtM5e XP Shop
description: Cart-based Experience-spending shop for Vampire/Ghoul characters - Attributes, Skills, Specialties, Disciplines (with Power picking), Blood Potency, and Advantages (Merits/Backgrounds), all costed per the V5 corebook's Trait Costs: Experience table (p.137). Replaces the Character Sheet's stock 'Spend Experience' dialog with a real browse-cart-checkout flow. Reads compendium data from vtm5e-clans, vtm5e-disciplines, and vtm5e-meritsflaws. Not published; built for personal use.
